description: Turn a session that just worked into permanent capability — journal what happened and why, then create or update the skills it implies so the next instance is one-shot. Use when you say "journal this", "let's create/update any skills based on what we did here", "make a skill for this", "/crystallize", "we'll be doing this again", "capture this", or at the end of any deep session that solved something genuinely novel and left nothing behind. Also handles the reverse: retiring skills when the work that grounded them is discontinued.
